title: Garlic Prawn and Spinach White Pizza
changes_from_base: A toasted garlic, anchovy and chilli oil replaces the tomato sauce, and baby spinach, pecorino, mozzarella and raw prawns bake together on a tray-shaped crust until the prawns turn pink.
summary: No-sauce pizza with garlicky, anchovy-infused oil, tender seafood, mild greens and melted cheese, finished with fresh parsley and a chilli kick.
equipment: rimmed baking tray, about 30 x 40 cm

ingredients.item: large raw prawns, peeled, deveined, tails off, cut into 2 cm pieces
fine sea salt or table salt
pizza dough, shop-bought or homemade, at room temperature

steps.title: Heat Oven
steps.text: Heat the oven to 260 °C with a shelf at the lowest position.

steps.title: Make Garlic Oil
steps.text: Warm oil (45 ml), chopped garlic (2 cloves), rinsed anchovies (2 fillets), pepper (¼ tsp) and chilli flakes (¼ tsp) in a small saucepan over medium, whisking to break up the anchovies, about 4 min until the garlic turns pale gold, tip into a bowl and cool.

steps.title: Prepare Prawns
steps.text: Pat prawns (340 g, cut into 2 cm pieces) dry, toss with salt (¼ tsp), oil (15 ml) and remaining pepper (¼ tsp).

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Brush the tray with oil (15 ml), press and roll the dough (450 g) to about 38 x 28 cm and lift onto the tray.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Spread the garlic oil over, lay spinach (30 g) on top, scatter pecorino romano (30 g grated), then mozzarella (225 g grated), dot the prawns over the cheese.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake 12-16 min, turning halfway, until the crust is deep golden underneath and the prawns are pink, opaque and reach 63 °C.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Cool 5 min on a rack, scatter chopped parsley (2 tbsp) and serve with extra chilli flakes.

tips: Pat the prawns completely dry before cooking so they sear and develop flavour rather than releasing moisture and steaming
Contains crustaceans (prawns) and fish (anchovies); the anchovies melt into the oil and add savoury depth rather than a fishy taste.
safety: Keep raw prawns separate from other ingredients until just before cooking to prevent cross-contamination with ready-to-eat foods
storage: Eat straight away whilst the crust is still warm; do not keep leftovers as prawns deteriorate quickly. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
